title: Flashcard file: data/<NN-slug>/cards.json
description: One fact per card. Word limits and the fields each type needs are checked by the card lint from SPEC.json (cards.*).

id.description: stable; the Anki note GUID is derived from it

type.description: writers write decide, differ, number and cannot; `cards build` generates term, meaning and partner (from data/terms.json), word (from data/exam-english.json) and say (from speak items with pack true)

front.description: names its context; a number card holds exactly one cloze {{c1::value}}; a partner card holds ___

back.description: the answer; empty string for a number (cloze) card

extra.description: one line of reason shown after the answer; may hold fact links

speak.description: speak item a say card is built from

section.description: '<file>#<section id>' the card depends on; null on generated cards

pair.description: id of a deliberately similar card

generated.description: true on cards that `cards build` writes (types term, meaning, partner, word, say); never set by a writer

tags.description: extra tags only; writers leave it empty, the export derives chapter, domain, type and trap tags from the fields
